title: 第7章 林昭雪第8章 仓木剑神
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 噬神塔！
秦易跟塔灵看着躺在地上的青衣女子，纵然受伤昏迷，依旧难掩其绝美容颜。
一头秀发随意披散，白皙的肌肤透着微红，五官精致，唇红齿白，身材高挑，让人有一种十分惊艳的感觉。
“她伤势有点重。”
塔灵检查了一下说道，“炼脉境九重的妖兽，远不是她能抵挡的，强行燃烧血脉之力，让她内脏受损严重，如不及时疗伤，会有生命危险。”
秦易略微思索片刻。
还是决定救这位青衣女子。
虽然他厌恶现在的修行环境，厌恶那些害死妹妹的人。
但是，他内心深处，还是一个淳朴稚嫩的少年。
扑哧！
突然，昏迷中的青衣女子口吐鲜血，生机在快速消散，体内仅存的血液，居然开始自燃。
“不好。”
塔灵暗叫一声不好，旋即袖袍一甩，将青衣女子的衣衫褪去，同时他也转过头去，“主人，她的血脉自燃，你尝试用太古吞神血脉，扑灭她体内的火焰。”
雪白肌肤，映入眼帘。
作为一个少年，秦易内心也有点躁动，他闭上眼睛不敢直视。
但是。
青衣女子的伤势太重，不一会儿火焰就笼罩全身。
这时，秦易也顾不得那么多了，盘膝坐在地上，将其扶起，双手抵在其雪白肌肤上。
顿时。
恐怖的太古吞神血脉，钻入了青衣女子的体内。
轰轰轰！
太古吞神血脉，号称太古最强血脉，可吞噬世间万物。
青衣女子的血脉，显然无法抵挡。
嘶嘶嘶！
肉眼可见，青衣女子自燃的火焰，逐渐熄灭。
然而。
就连秦易都没有发现，青衣女子的血液，接触到太古吞神血脉的那一刻，噬神塔第一层中的仓木剑神的骨骸，射出了一道微弱的光芒。
片刻后。
秦易收回双手，青衣女子的伤势，已经得到控制。
他随便找了一件衣服，给青衣女子穿上。
“她没事了吧？”秦易问道。
塔灵道：“没有生命危险了，但是受伤太重，短时间内，无法恢复。”
青衣女子的手略微抖动了一下，秦易见状，急忙带着她离开了噬神塔。
噬神塔是自己最大的秘密，绝不能让任何人知晓。
青云山脉，核心之地。
秦易刚刚将青衣女子放在地上，后者睫毛抖动，缓缓睁开双眸。
content_en:
God-Eating Tower!
Qin Yi and Ta Ling looked at the woman in green lying on the ground. Even though she was injured and unconscious, her beautiful face could not be concealed.
Her hair is spread freely, her fair skin is slightly reddish, her facial features are exquisite, her lips are red and her teeth are white, and her figure is tall, which makes people feel very stunning.
"She's a little bit seriously injured."
The tower spirit checked it out and said, "The monster at the ninth level of the Pulse Refining Realm is far beyond what she can resist. It forcibly burned the power of her bloodline, causing severe damage to her internal organs. If not treated in time, her life will be in danger."
Qin Yi thought for a moment.
Still decided to save the woman in green.
Although he hates the current cultivation environment and those who killed his sister.
However, deep down, he is still a simple and naive young man.
Phew!
Suddenly, the unconscious woman in Tsing Yi vomited blood. Her vitality was rapidly disappearing, and the remaining blood in her body actually began to spontaneously ignite.
"Not good."
The tower spirit secretly screamed something bad, and immediately flicked his sleeves and robes to take off the clothes of the woman in blue. At the same time, he turned his head and said, "Master, her bloodline ignited spontaneously. You try to use the ancient swallowing god bloodline to extinguish the flames in her body."
Snow-white skin comes into view.
As a young man, Qin Yi was a little restless in his heart. He closed his eyes and did not dare to look directly.
but.
The woman in green was so seriously injured that flames soon covered her body.
At this time, Qin Yi didn't care so much anymore. He sat cross-legged on the ground, lifted him up, and put his hands on his snow-white skin.
Suddenly.
The terrifying ancient swallowing god bloodline penetrated into the body of the woman in green.
Boom boom boom!
The ancient swallowing god bloodline is known as the strongest bloodline in ancient times and can swallow everything in the world.
The bloodline of the woman in green was obviously irresistible.
Hiss!
Visible to the naked eye, the self-igniting flame of the woman in green gradually extinguished.
However.
Even Qin Yi didn't notice that the moment the blood of the woman in green came into contact with the blood of the ancient God-devouring God, the bones of Cangmu Sword God in the first floor of the God-devouring Tower emitted a faint light.
After a while.
Qin Yi retracted his hands, and the injury of the woman in green was already under control.
He found a random piece of clothing and put it on the woman in green.
"Is she okay?" Qin Yi asked.
Ta Ling said: "It is not life-threatening, but the injury is too serious and cannot be recovered in a short time."
The woman's hand in green trembled slightly. Seeing this, Qin Yi hurriedly took her away from the God-Eating Tower.
The God-Eating Tower is his biggest secret, and he must not let anyone know about it.
Qingyun Mountains, the core place.
Qin Yi just put the woman in green on the ground. The latter's eyelashes trembled and she slowly opened her eyes.
